summary: Meera cold-called Mr Nikhil at a retailer with 120+ stores. The prospect has a mixed-model approach with significant automation connected through their business management system, with head office managing full visibility. Declined interest and asked not to be called again.
key_findings: Fully automated: "The essential processes are automated and connected through our business management system. Head office manages it, and we have full visibility."
Uses a mixed model for local expenses.
Clear rejection: "If a particular need comes up later, we will reach out."

evidence.text: We have quite a lot of automation, with a mixed model where needed. The essential processes are automated and connected through our business management system.
there is also a separate department here monitoring this every day

next_actions: Do not follow up further. Prospect asked not to be contacted again.
Note for team: suppress this number/contact from future outbound lists.
Document competitive insight: large retailer with integrated BMS.
coaching_notes: Meera was transparent about the cold call nature and gathered useful intel about the prospect's setup. Good question about cash advances vs. cards — this is the kind of qualifying question that helps. The prospect was firm but polite.
